description: An upstream rate-limit reply (429 with Retry-After and a Google error body) reaches the Gemini client as a 429 with the upstream's error body.
source: core/internal/runtime/executor/gemini_executor.go:226-237,252-266 (non-stream error statuses use the upstream HTTP status and the parsed Google status error)
core/sdk/api/handlers/gemini/gemini_handlers.go:137-177 (error response written with the upstream status)

error.message: Resource has been exhausted (e.g. check quota).

exceptions.reason: The new core passes the upstream's Retry-After on to a rate-limited client (RFC 9110 section 10.2.3); today's Gemini path sends none.

A request in the upstream's own format passes through unchanged (the plan's same-format passthrough). Today's core rewrites it: it adds model and default safetySettings that turn every filter off, renames functionDeclarations to function_declarations, parameters to parametersJsonSchema and responseSchema to responseJsonSchema, fills in empty functionResponse names, and replaces a thoughtSignature it does not recognise as one Gemini issued (as with this case's synthetic signature) with skip_thought_signature_validator, which throws that reasoning state away. The new core keeps every thought signature on the part it came with, unchecked.
